summary: BTC Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2) after its closing bid price exceeded $1.00 per share for 10 consecutive business days from August 20 to September 2, 2026. The company had previously received a deficiency letter on August 27, 2026, and was granted a 180-day cure period until February 23, 2027. Nasdaq confirmed compliance on September 3, 2026, closing the matter. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms or strategic actions are involved.
